title: Lollipop counter boundary edge case
description: The lollipop counter at lines 43-65 handles version 0 arriving after 255 as newer (correct per RFC 6550). However, a reset-to-0 vs normal-wrap-to-0 cannot be distinguished. Consider adding a test vector for version_is_newer(0, 255) and documenting this spec-compliant but surprising behavior.
